evenOdd.title: Find Even and Odd Numbers

evenOdd.problem: Given a list of integers, print whether each number is even or odd.

steps.heading: Create the list
steps.text: The list stores four integers: 10, 7, 4 and 9.

steps.heading: Visit each number
steps.text: The for loop processes one list item at a time.

steps.heading: Check divisibility by 2
steps.text: A remainder of zero means the number is even.

steps.heading: Choose the correct branch
steps.text: if handles even numbers; else handles odd numbers.

steps.heading: Print every classification
steps.text: The program prints the category for all four numbers.

fibonacci.title: Print Fibonacci Series

fibonacci.problem: Given n = 7, print the first seven Fibonacci numbers starting from 0.

steps.heading: Set the number of terms
steps.text: n is 7, so the loop runs seven times.

steps.heading: Initialize the sequence
steps.text: The first two values are a = 0 and b = 1.

steps.heading: Repeat for each term
steps.text: The loop prints the current a value.

steps.heading: Update both values
steps.text: The next pair becomes the old b and a + b.

steps.heading: Finish the series
steps.text: Seven values have been printed.

steps.text: The list contains five values to compare.

steps.heading: Assume the first is largest

steps.heading: Compare each value
steps.text: Each number is compared with the current largest.

steps.heading: Update when needed
steps.text: The largest value changes from 12 to 45, then to 89.

steps.heading: Print the answer
steps.text: 89 is the largest value in the list.

steps.text: No even values have been counted yet.

steps.heading: Initialize total

steps.heading: Store the number

steps.heading: Loop from 1 to 10

steps.heading: Multiply each time

steps.heading: Print each row

reverseNumber.title: Reverse a Number
reverseNumber.intro: Reverse an integer using arithmetic, not string conversion.
reverseNumber.problem: Reverse the digits of 12345 using arithmetic operations only.

steps.heading: Store the number
steps.text: Start with n = 12345.

steps.heading: Initialize the result
steps.text: The reversed number starts at zero.

steps.heading: Extract the last digit
steps.text: n % 10 gives the final digit, 5.

steps.heading: Append the digit
steps.text: Multiply the result by 10 and add the digit.

steps.heading: Remove the digit
steps.text: Integer division removes the last digit from n.

steps.heading: Print the result
steps.text: After all digits are processed, the result is 54321.

factorial.title: Factorial of a Number
factorial.intro: Calculate n! using a loop; 0! is 1.
factorial.problem: Calculate the factorial of n = 5. Remember that 0! = 1.

steps.heading: Store n
steps.text: The requested number is 5.

steps.heading: Start with one
steps.text: Factorial is a product, so initialize result to 1.

steps.heading: Loop from 1 to n
steps.text: The loop visits 1, 2, 3, 4 and 5.

steps.heading: Multiply the result
steps.text: The running product becomes 1, 2, 6, 24 and 120.

steps.heading: Display factorial
steps.text: The factorial of 5 is 120.

prime.title: Check Prime Number
prime.intro: Check whether a number has any divisor other than 1 and itself.

steps.heading: Store the number
steps.text: We need to test n = 17.

steps.heading: Check the starting condition
steps.text: A prime number must be greater than 1.

steps.heading: Try possible divisors
steps.text: Test integers from 2 through the square root of 17.

steps.heading: Look for a remainder of zero
steps.text: None of these values divides 17 evenly.

steps.heading: Print the result
steps.text: No divisor was found, so 17 is prime.
